name: # Species- and system-specific constants for REEIM.slim (North Sea plaice
# SENSITIVITY SET: identical to ../plaice except the growth constants and the priors scaled from them.
# Any value given on the command line with -d overrides the value here.
# Write integers without a decimal point (e.g. 10000) and reals with one (e.g. 62.0).
# Growth constants: posterior means of the deterministic growth ABC (REEIM/plaice_validation/growth_fit/) on female DATRAS BTS Q3 2015-2020 size-at-age;
# tri-phasic growth with L_T = 219 mm fixed and g free (deterministic ABC model 5; g absorbs density effects
# Sexes are pooled in the model; reference values and observed data are for females
# Inferred parameters: defaults for standalone runs only (ABC-SMC sets them with -d)
f
description: fecundity scaling

name: w
description: cost of fecundity

name: Shmax
description: directional viability cost on h_max

name: SLT
description: directional viability cost on L_T

name: H
description: terminal harvest intensity (fraction of biomass); assessed catch/TSB 2020 = 0.078

name: LTLim
description: L_T above which there is no viability cost (mm); perch ratio LTLim/LTPrior = 1.48 kept

name: hmaxLim
description: h_max below which there is no viability cost (mm/yr)

name: K
description: carrying capacity

name: maxAge
description: maximum age (years); plaice reach 50 (FishBase) and M = 0.1

name: # Reference trait values (scale mutational effects and initial state; not priors)
LTPrior
description: reference size at maturation L_T (mm) = LT_obs (female L50 NS-IBTS Q1 2015-2020)

name: gPrior
description: reference reproductive investment g; tri-phasic growth with L_T = 219 mm fixed and g free (deterministic ABC model 5; g absorbs density effects; issue I-18)

name: hmaxPrior
description: reference maximum growth rate h_max (mm/yr) = fitted h (99.4) times 1 + gamma*DK^delta (1.616) as for perch (38.3 -> 62)

name: gi
description: immature growth cost (same fit as gPrior)

name: h0
description: first-year growth multiplier (same fit as gPrior)

name: gamma
description: density-dependence scale (perch/pike value)

name: delta
description: density-dependence exponent (perch/pike value)

name: DK
description: density at K (perch/pike value)

name: sd
description: mutational SD (relative to reference trait values)

name: u
description: mutation rate after cycle 2000

name: Ve
description: environmental variance (relative)

name: # Length-weight relationship W = a * L^b (W in g
description: North Sea 1998-2009 (FishBase: a = 0.00590

name: a
description: length-weight coefficient

name: b
description: length-weight exponent

name: Tdelta
description: burn-in length (cycles) before fishing starts

name: initAgeMax
description: initial ages drawn uniformly from 0 to this value

name: burninMedianSizeMin
description: abort if median size (mm) falls below this at a burn-in check (survey median ~160 mm; tune on test runs)

name: burninMedianSizeMax
description: abort if median size (mm) exceeds this at a burn-in check (tune on test runs)

name: burninAgeQ99Min
description: abort if the 99th age percentile falls below this at a burn-in check

name: burninAgeQ99Max
description: abort if the 99th age percentile exceeds this at a burn-in check

name: # Size selectivity (classes are read from selectivity.csv): 80 mm beam-trawl codend retention
# (L50 14.4 cm
value: selection range 2.4 cm; Molenaar & Chen 2018) times discard mortality 0.85 below the 27 cm minimum size

name: selBinWidth
description: width of the size classes in selectivity.csv (mm)

name: selBelow
description: vulnerability of fish smaller than the first class

name: selAbove
description: vulnerability of fish larger than the last class
